facts.title: Learn Mining
facts.note: No skill or level needed; teaches to skill 75. Junior trainers teach only this rank. Poor Copper Veins in the starting zones give Copper Ore and Rough Stone from level 1.

facts.title: Lodestone (Mining 20)
facts.location: Mining trainer, or the Camping 101 quest
facts.note: 1 Rough Stone and 1 Copper Bar. Melee attack power; does not stack with Blessing of Might.

facts.title: Journeyman Mining at skill 50
facts.note: No level requirement for any Mining rank: Journeyman at 50, Expert at 125, Artisan at 200, all from the same trainers.

facts.title: Copper to skill 70, Tin from 65
facts.location: Level 10-20 zones: Westfall, Loch Modan, the Barrens, Silverpine Forest
facts.note: Smelt Copper and Tin into Bronze. Ore nodes respawn faster the more players are nearby. Rockslicer, from Rhahk'Zor in the Deadmines, mines Copper, Tin, Silver and Iron veins without the profession (30 uses).
